policy: Golden Pipeline IR documents backing the round-trip, totality, and DAG-validation pins. Every listed fixture is canonical text (text === serialize(parse(text))) except architecture-example.yaml, which is the architecture §5 literal and is pinned to canonicalize to customer_portfolio.yaml. Synthetic only; regenerate the sha256 values deliberately with the fixture change.
